Job Title: GenAI Engineer

Experience: 5 to 9 years
Location: Hyderabad/Bangalore/Chennai
Employment Type: Full Time, Permanent




Job Description

We are looking for an experienced GenAI Engineer to build and deploy Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions using Anthropic Claude. You will work with software engineers, data scientists, and DevOps teams to deliver reliable, production-grade AI applications.




Key Responsibilities

Develop and integrate Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions using Anthropic Claude
Build Claude-based applications, AI agents, and workflows, and integrate them with APIs and enterprise applications
Develop applications using Python, FastAPI, and REST APIs
Work on prompt engineering and RAG-based solutions to improve the quality of AI responses
Test, troubleshoot, and optimize GenAI applications for performance, accuracy, and reliability
Collaborate with software engineers, data scientists, and DevOps teams to deliver GenAI solutions



Required Skills

5 to 9 years of software development experience
Hands-on experience with Anthropic Claude / Claude APIs
Strong Python development experience
Experience with FastAPI and REST APIs
Knowledge of Generative AI, Agentic AI, prompt engineering, and RAG
Good communication and problem-solving skills



Thanks & Regards

TA Team

Excelra
